poses.label: Standing, front
poses.instruction: Standing straight facing the camera, weight even, arms relaxed beside the body with a small gap from the torso, feet hip-width apart.

poses.label: Standing, front, feet together
poses.instruction: Standing straight facing the camera, feet together, arms hanging straight and close to the body so the full side seams of a dress would be visible.

poses.label: Standing, back
poses.instruction: Seen from directly behind, standing straight, arms relaxed beside the body, feet hip-width apart. Back of the head toward the camera.

poses.label: Standing, left profile
poses.instruction: Strict left profile, body side-on facing the left edge of the frame, arms relaxed, feet slightly apart.

poses.label: Standing, right profile
poses.instruction: Strict right profile, body side-on facing the right edge of the frame, arms relaxed, feet slightly apart.

poses.label: Standing, three-quarter left
poses.instruction: Body turned about 45 degrees toward the left edge of the frame, head turned slightly back toward the camera, arms relaxed.

poses.label: Standing, three-quarter right
poses.instruction: Body turned about 45 degrees toward the right edge of the frame, head turned slightly back toward the camera, arms relaxed.

poses.label: Standing, back three-quarter
poses.instruction: Seen from behind and slightly to the side, body turned about 45 degrees away from the camera, arms relaxed, head turned slightly toward the side.

poses.label: Right hand on hip, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, right hand resting on the hip with the elbow out, left arm relaxed, weight on the left leg, right knee slightly bent.

poses.label: Left hand on hip, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, left hand resting on the hip with the elbow out, right arm relaxed, weight on the right leg, left knee slightly bent.

poses.label: Both hands on hips, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, both hands on the hips with the elbows out, feet shoulder-width apart, upright confident stance.

poses.label: Hand on hip, three-quarter
poses.instruction: Body turned about 45 degrees to the right, right hand on the hip, left arm relaxed, one foot slightly forward.

poses.label: Walking toward camera, right foot forward
poses.instruction: Mid-stride walking toward the camera, right foot forward, arms swinging naturally, steps of moderate length, upright posture.

poses.label: Walking toward camera, left foot forward
poses.instruction: Mid-stride walking toward the camera, left foot forward, arms swinging naturally, steps of moderate length, upright posture.

poses.label: Walking, left profile
poses.instruction: Mid-stride walking in strict left profile toward the left edge of the frame, one foot ahead of the other, arms swinging gently.

poses.label: Walking, right profile
poses.instruction: Mid-stride walking in strict right profile toward the right edge of the frame, one foot ahead of the other, arms swinging gently.

poses.label: Walking away
poses.instruction: Seen from behind, mid-stride walking away from the camera, one foot ahead, arms swinging gently.

poses.label: Runway pause, front
poses.instruction: Runway pause facing the camera: one foot placed slightly in front of the other, hips slightly angled, arms relaxed at the sides.

poses.label: Right forearm raised, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, right elbow bent with the forearm held up across the front of the torso at waist height, left arm relaxed. Leave the pose open so a dupatta could drape over the forearm.

poses.label: Both forearms forward, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, both elbows bent and both forearms held forward at waist height, hands slightly apart, as if holding the ends of a scarf. Hands empty.

poses.label: Left hand at shoulder, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, left hand raised to touch the left shoulder as if adjusting a dupatta, right arm relaxed. Hand empty.

poses.label: Right hand at shoulder, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, right hand raised to touch the right shoulder as if adjusting a dupatta, left arm relaxed. Hand empty.

poses.label: Both hands low behind, back
poses.instruction: Seen from behind, both arms slightly bent and held a little away from the body so a dupatta's back drape would stay visible.

poses.label: Forearm raised, left profile
poses.instruction: Strict left profile, near forearm raised in front of the torso at waist height, elbow bent, other arm relaxed.

poses.label: Arms crossed, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, arms crossed loosely at the waist, upright posture, feet hip-width apart.

poses.label: Hands clasped, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, both hands lightly clasped in front of the waist, shoulders relaxed, feet together.

poses.label: Hands behind back, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, both hands held behind the back, chest slightly open, feet hip-width apart.

poses.label: One hand to hair, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, right hand raised toward the side of the head, left arm relaxed, head slightly tilted, weight on the left leg.

poses.label: Hands at skirt level, front
poses.instruction: Facing the camera, both hands slightly lifted at hip level and held a little away from the body, as if gathering a long skirt. Hands empty.

poses.label: Looking back over shoulder
poses.instruction: Body turned away from the camera at three-quarter back, head turned back over the left shoulder toward the camera, arms relaxed.

poses.label: Seated on a stool, front
poses.instruction: Seated on a simple plain grey cube stool facing the camera, back straight, knees together, hands resting on the thighs. The stool is part of the pose.

poses.label: Seated on a stool, left profile
poses.instruction: Seated on a simple plain grey cube stool in strict left profile, back straight, knees together, hands resting on the thighs.
